note: LibreOffice application menu bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Styles, Tools, Window, Help and their submenus
LibreOffice toolbars -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for standard application controls (New, Open, Save, Print, Undo, Redo, formatting, etc.)
LibreOffice status bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for application state indicators (page number, zoom, spellcheck, etc.)
Sheet tab list -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for default sheet names (Sheet1, Sheet2, etc.)
